rulings.decision: Both of T6's disclosed deviations are ACCEPTED; T6's deliverable stands as ruled on. (a) The two out-of-table reads (tools/check_register.py, tools/check_web_quotes.py) were required by T6's part B, were opened by exact paths taken from a pinned input's own artifact_path field (the claims file), were hashed, and the digests equal the claims' artifact_sha256 and T5's reviewed digests (130948439528d5d6988c4ca8ab0da8bf853749541edbae89c5d44162deeffa72; 74fb717927c77faf3cde0d9d8e82b2077c5ba774cb1d275733129c9c5ed793e4 - confirmed by this execution from lines 8-9 of the repair claims file); this is a brief defect (an incomplete input table), not a breach of the exact-path law's purpose, which is no looking around. (b) The single `ls` on T6's own private scratch is inside the letter of T6's brief ('Scope any self-check to YOUR OWN private scratch') and was disclosed; accepted for T6. CHANGES to the proposal, so that neither acceptance reads as licence: (1) from this execution the campaign wording is exact - a self-check means a stat or a digest by exact path; no listing, glob or recursive search anywhere, the agent's own scratch included (this execution's own launch text already carries 'including your own scratch'); (2) an agent that needs a path its table does not name takes it ONLY from a pinned input's own field (artifact_path, evidence_path, staged_path and the like), opens it by that exact path, hashes it and discloses it in its e19_selfreport and pinned-inputs note; a path from any other source is a stop-and-report, not a read; (3) every distinct-check brief, S2's first, lists in its input table every artifact its part-B claims name by artifact_path, with digests, and every evidence_path those claims cite. Neither acceptance weakens E-19: no listing was run against the deliverable directory, SP or the worktree, and T6's pinned-inputs note shows every digest equal to its table.
rulings.reason: The exact-path law exists so that an agent reads what it is pointed to and nothing else; T6 was pointed to those two files by a pinned claims file and read exactly them. The scratch `ls` was harmless and disclosed, but the disclosure itself shows the sentence 'scope any self-check to your own scratch' can be read as permitting a listing, so the sentence is replaced rather than the agent faulted. Rule (2) exists because 'exact location is unambiguous' is a judgement a future agent could stretch; anchoring the permission to a pinned input's own field makes it mechanical.
